verdict.justification: The project aims to improve the management of digital non-numeric content in the academic coordinations of Universidad del Valle - Sede Caicedonia through the development of a web-based enterprise content management system (ECM). The system facilitates support for the main tasks of the digital content lifecycle using an ECM architecture with a centralized and scalable storage mechanism, utilizing the MySQL database engine in conjunction with the LILY document repository, a presentation layer preceded by the Web Oneye operating system, and a set of metadata-oriented tools, including the SOLR indexing engine.
